tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bla ma'i thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi zhal gdams le'u drug pa'i bla ma 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge'i sgrub thabs gsal bar byed pa blo gros dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyug ma'i ye shes ral gri yis// ma rig sgrib pa'i drwa ba bsal// blo gros snang ba rab rgyas nas// kun mkhyen thob 'dod 'dir 'jug bya// de yang bla ma'i thugs sgrub zhal gdams snying byang gi le'u drug par gsungs pa'i/ bla ma dang 'jam dbyangs smra ba'i seng ge dbyer med du bsgom zhing sgrub par byed pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gang du sgrub pa'i gnas su sku gsung thugs rten bkram/ gtor ma dkar zlum dkar gsum mngar gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' bca' sna tshogs pas bskor/ sman raka nyer spyod sogs yo byad phun sum tshogs par byas nas/ sngon 'gro spyi chings sbar khab ltar bya/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po bskyed rim ni/ a: chos sku de bzhin nyid dbyings 'od gsal ngang: longs sku 'gag med kun snang snying rje'i rtsal: sprul sku rgyu yi ting 'dzin hrīḥdakar po: de las 'od 'phros snod bcud dngos 'dzin sbyangs: 'byung ba rim brtsegs rdo rje'i srung 'khor dbus: bh+rūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas mtshan nyid rdzogs: lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: hrīḥlas smra ba'i seng ge paṇ+ḍi ta: dkar gsal 'od ldan gsal 'tsher gzi brjid 'bar: phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad phyag rgya yis: pad sdong snyan gyi thad kar kha bye'i dbus: g.yas su sde snod 'dus pa'i glegs bam dang: g.yon pa gsang sngags phur pa'i pustis mtshan: dge slong cha lugs paṇa zhwa dmar po gsol: rab 'byams mkhyen rab rgyas pa'i sku ru gsal: phyi rol pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar la: shar du 'jam dpal dpa' bo sku mdog dkar: lho ru ngag gi dbang phyug gur gum mdog: nub tu gsung gi mnga' bdag sku mdog dmar: byang du rdo rje rnon po mthing nag 'bar: kun kyang shes rab ral gri pusti bsnams: dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan skyil krung bzhugs:

shar lhor rdo rje'i dbyangs can zla ba'i mdog: lho nub rin chen dbyangs can gser mdangs 'tsher: nub byang pad+ma'i dbyangs can sku mdog dmar: byang shar las kyi dbyangs can margad mdog: thams cad phyag gnyis rin chen pi waṃ sgreng: dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs tsog pur bzhugs: sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang: bar mtshams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs: snang stong zung 'jug ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor lhun grub cing: ye shes rigs lnga'i dbang mchog rdzogs par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gnyis pa ye shes spyan drangs shing bstim pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī: yul gyi ming ni lho nub rnga yab gling: sprul pa'i zhing mchog pad+ma drwa ba nas: sku gsum dbyer med o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i 'khor dang bcas: mos pa'i gnas 'dir gdung bas spyan 'dren na: thugs rje thugs dam dbang gis gshegs nas kyang: bar chad kun sol mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las thams cad rdzogs: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro ba ma lus sgrol: yid bzhin nor ltar dngos grub char 'beb pa'i: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi mchod 'dod yon rgya mtsho sprin ltar gtibs: nang mchod sman rag gtor tshogs bsam mi khyab: gsang mchod bde stong zung 'jug ye shes dbyings: 'bul lo bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shab+da sarba pañtsa rak+ta ba liṃ ta ma hā pū dza āḥhūm̐: bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ: mkhyen rab ye shes snang ba rgyas pa'i dpal: rig 'dzin yongs gtso skye 'chi gnyis spangs pa:

yang le shod kyi paṇa chen smra ba'i seng: phyogs las rnam par rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus gsum rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam dpal dbyangs: rgyal kun bskyed yum lha mo dbyangs can ma: gang 'dul rigs bzhi'i sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar: dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: lnga pa dzap bzlas ni/ dzap khang dbye dgos na/ hrīḥphaṭa dzaḥ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ hūm̐ hrī: snying po byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i lha tshogs rnams: mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig dgyes dgongs la: byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes bskul/ bzlas dmigs ni/ rig 'dzin smra ba'i seng ge'i thugs ka ru: zla steng hrīḥmathar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: 'od 'phros 'gro kun ma rig mun pa bsal: rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi ye shes dang: nyan rang 'phags dang so skye'i blo gros kun: 'od kyi rnam par tshur 'dus rang la thim: mkhyen rab ye shes snang ba rgyas par bsam: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma pra dzñā dzñā na sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: 'khor rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ wā kye daṃ na ma: 'jam dbyangs dkar po 'o// oṃ wā gi shwa ri muṃ: ngag gi dbang phyug go / oṃ hrīḥdhīḥm me diḥpaṃ mañdzu shrī muṃ hrīḥpra dzñā bar+dha ni hrīḥdhīḥswā hā: smra seng ngo*// oṃ mañdzu shrī badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa: rdo rje rnon po 'o// hrīṃ hrīṃ hrīṃ: rdo rje dbyangs can no// oṃ swa ra swa t+yai ma hā me dhi tiṣ+ṭha ku ru hūm̐: rin chen dbyangs can no// oṃ swa ra swa t+yai hrīṃḥhrīṃḥhrīṃ: pad+ma dbyangs can no// oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pra dzñā bar+dha ni: dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhi bar+dha ni: dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā: las kyi dbyangs can no// rgyal chen bzhi ni/ oṃ ḍhṛṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa ya swā hā: oṃ bi rū ḍha ka ya swā hā:

oṃ bi rū pāk+ṣa ya swā hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya swā hā: thun mthar/ oṃ/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod// bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// ma hā pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi/ zhes mchod bstod bshags nas thal mo sbyar/ oṃ: dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi: mkhyen rab ye shes gcig bsdus pa: rigs rnams kun bdag che ba'i mchog: bla ma smra ba'i seng ge dang: dbyer med 'jam mgon dbyangs can ma: thabs shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha: gtso 'khor sprul par bcas pa rnams: bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol: thugs rje chen pos byin gyis rlobs: ye shes snang ba rgyas pa dang: gzungs dran mngon shes ting nge 'dzin: 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa dang: dus 'di nas ni byang chub bar: rig 'dzin bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs: dge ba'i bshes su gyur nas kyang: kun mkhyen ye shes myur thob shog: thun mtshams phyag bskor maṇ+ḍal 'bul: 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud: bklag dang 'dzin pa nyid du bya: des zla ba gcig gam: ji ltar 'gor yang zla ba drug gi mthar dngos su bla ma 'jam dbyangs yab yum zhal mjal ba dang: sngags kyi sgra thos pa: ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab skye ba: rmi lam du sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan ma rnyed pa: nyi zla shar ba: me tog dang: 'bras bu dang: chu bo chen po rgyas pa: me 'bar ba sogs rtags byung na blo gros phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ro: dzap khang dbye yod na hūm̐ zhes ye shes pa rang la bstim mo// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba spyi chings ltar bya'o// 'di'i mthus shes bya bsam gyis mi khyab pa// de kun blo yis rab mkhyen shes rab mchog /pha rol phyin pa 'jam dpal dpa' bo yi// go 'phang gdod ma'i dbyings su thob gyur cig /ces zur mang bya btang ras chung dpon slob rnams kyi bzhed pa'i ngor thams cad mkhyen pa paṇ+ḍi ta rnga yab pa chen po'i thugs rjes nye bar 'tsho ba/

mchog gyur gling pas dus tshes dge bar zur mang rnam rgyal rtse'i pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge sbyong rgan po lnga rig smra ba chos rgyal gyis bgyis pa'i dge ba des kyang*/ 'gro kun ma rig pa'i sgrib pa las grol te mkhyen rab kyi snang ba rgyas nas mgon po kun gzigs kyi go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /dge'o/// /
